issues.title: No Direct Answer in First 60 Words
issues.description: This page does not deliver a direct answer within the first 60 words of body content. AI extraction systems are unlikely to select it for answer-layer citations.
issues.recommendation: Restructure the opening paragraph to lead with the key answer or definition. Move all context and background after the first 2-3 substantive sentences.

issues.title: H2 Headings Are Not Question-Optimized
issues.description: Fewer than 30% of H2 headings are phrased as questions. AI systems prefer section headings that mirror user query patterns for section-level extraction.
issues.recommendation: Rephrase at least 30% of H2 headings as natural language questions that reflect what a user would ask about each section's topic.

issues.title: Answer Buried Behind Long Introduction
issues.description: The page opens with more than 100 words of introductory content before delivering any substantive answer. AI systems weight early content most heavily for extraction.
issues.recommendation: Move the key answer or primary claim to the top of the page. Context, background, and brand narrative should follow the answer, not precede it.

issues.title: FAQ Schema Contains Entries With No Visible Content Match
issues.description: One or more FAQ schema entries have no corresponding visible question/answer pair on the page. Schema/content mismatches risk rich result penalties and degrade AI extraction accuracy.
issues.recommendation: For each mismatched entry: either add the Q&A as visible content on the page, or remove the entry from the FAQPage schema. Every schema FAQ must have a visible counterpart.

issues.title: Insufficient List Formatting for AI Extraction
issues.description: This page has fewer than 2 qualifying lists (each needing 3+ items). List-formatted content is the primary target for AI list-snippet extraction.
issues.recommendation: Convert key sections (steps, features, benefits, requirements) into bullet or numbered lists with at least 3 items each.

issues.title: No Authoritative External Sources Cited
issues.description: This page makes claims but cites no authoritative external sources (.gov, .edu, recognised industry authorities). AI quality evaluators weight citations as credibility signals.
issues.recommendation: Add 1-3 outbound links to authoritative sources that directly support your page's key claims.

issues.title: Comparison Content Not Structured as Table
issues.description: This page discusses comparisons but has no qualifying HTML table. AI systems cannot extract structured comparative data from prose.
issues.recommendation: Convert comparison content into an HTML table with clear column headers and one row per compared item.

issues.title: HowTo Schema Missing on Process Page
issues.description: This page describes a step-by-step process but lacks HowTo schema, missing rich result eligibility and AI step-extraction accuracy.
issues.recommendation: Add HowTo schema with numbered steps matching the page's instructional content. Each step must include a 'name' and 'text' property.

issues.title: Speakable Schema Missing
issues.description: No Speakable schema found. Voice assistants cannot identify which sections of this page to read aloud for spoken AI responses.
issues.recommendation: Add Speakable schema targeting your summary paragraph and H1. Use stable CSS selectors (e.g. '.article-summary', 'h1') not dynamic IDs.

opportunities.title: AggregateRating Schema Missing
opportunities.description: Add AggregateRating schema to your LocalBusiness with ratingValue, reviewCount, and bestRating properties if your business has verifiable reviews.

opportunities.title: No SameAs Links Declared
opportunities.description: Add a sameAs array to your LocalBusiness schema pointing to your Google Business Profile, Wikidata entry, and major directory profiles.

issues.title: LocalBusiness Schema Missing
issues.description: No LocalBusiness schema found. AI systems and knowledge graph engines cannot identify this business as a local entity, making geographic entity association impossible.
issues.recommendation: Add LocalBusiness schema (or a specific subtype matching your business category) with complete name, PostalAddress, telephone, and URL in JSON-LD in the <head>.

issues.title: NAP Inconsistency — Schema and Visible Text Do Not Match
issues.description: The business Name, Address, or Phone in structured schema does not match what appears as visible text on the page. Inconsistent NAP signals confuse knowledge graph entity resolution.
issues.recommendation: Ensure the business name, address, and phone number in your LocalBusiness schema exactly match the visible NAP text on your contact or homepage.

issues.title: GeoCoordinates Missing from LocalBusiness Schema
issues.description: LocalBusiness schema lacks precise coordinates. Knowledge graph systems must rely on address text parsing alone, introducing entity matching ambiguity.
issues.recommendation: Add a GeoCoordinates object inside your LocalBusiness schema with accurate latitude and longitude decimal values.

issues.title: Business Hours Not in Structured Schema
issues.description: AI assistants cannot answer 'is this business open?' queries because OpeningHoursSpecification is missing from the LocalBusiness schema.
issues.recommendation: Add OpeningHoursSpecification entries to your LocalBusiness schema for every operating day, using ISO 8601 time format (HH:MM).

issues.title: City Name Missing from H1 or Opening Content
issues.description: The target city does not appear in the H1 and/or the opening 100 words. Geographic relevance signals are weakened for local AI queries.
issues.recommendation: Include the city name naturally in the H1 heading and within the first 100 words of body text. One natural mention in each position is sufficient.

issues.title: Service Schema Missing
issues.description: This service page has no Service schema markup. AI systems cannot extract structured service details such as name, description, or provider — reducing citation probability for service queries.
issues.recommendation: Add a Service JSON-LD block to this page with at minimum: name, description, provider (linked to your Organization), and serviceType.

issues.title: AggregateRating Schema Missing
issues.description: No AggregateRating schema found. Review signals in structured data strengthen entity trust and corroborate brand reputation to knowledge graph systems.
issues.recommendation: Add AggregateRating schema to your LocalBusiness with ratingValue, reviewCount, and bestRating properties if your business has verifiable reviews.

issues.title: No SameAs Links Declared
issues.description: LocalBusiness schema has no sameAs property linking to authoritative external profiles. Without these, knowledge graph systems cannot corroborate entity identity across platforms.
issues.recommendation: Add a sameAs array to your LocalBusiness schema pointing to your Google Business Profile, Wikidata entry, and major directory profiles.

issues.title: Google Maps Embed Missing
issues.description: No Google Maps embed found. The direct visual and technical link between this page and the Maps knowledge graph entity is absent.
issues.recommendation: Embed a Google Maps iframe on your contact or location page using the embed URL from Google Maps > Share > Embed a map.

issues.title: Hreflang Missing on Multi-Locale Site
issues.description: Your site serves content in multiple languages or regions but lacks hreflang tags. AI systems and search engines cannot correctly attribute regional entity versions to geographic queries.
issues.recommendation: Implement hreflang link elements for all language/region combinations. Include a self-referencing tag on every page and an x-default fallback. Use BCP-47 language codes (e.g. en-US, fr-FR).

issues.title: About / Company Information Not Detectable
issues.description: No About page link or company information was found. AI systems use company context to validate entity authority and filter low-trust sources.
issues.recommendation: Add an About page and link to it from the main navigation. Include company name, founding context, and mission on that page.

issues.title: Insufficient Internal Linking
issues.description: This page has fewer than 3 internal links, limiting AI crawlers' ability to discover related content and understand topical structure.
issues.recommendation: Add at least 3 contextually relevant internal links to related pages on your site.

issues.title: Page Is Orphaned
issues.description: No other page on the site links to this page internally, making it unreachable via normal crawling or site navigation.
issues.recommendation: Add at least one internal link to this page from a relevant hub, category, or navigation page.

issues.title: Insufficient Content Depth
issues.description: Page body content is under 300 words — too thin for AI systems to extract substantive answers or reliable citations.
issues.recommendation: Expand the page to at least 300 words of substantive, topic-relevant body content.

issues.title: llms.txt File Missing
issues.description: No llms.txt found. AI crawlers lack a structured signal for which pages to prioritise.
issues.recommendation: Create an llms.txt file at your domain root following the llmstxt.org specification.

data.basis: Ordered by the finding's own severity, then pages affected, then easier fixes first. Action text is stored guidance from the audit; where none is stored, none is shown.

data.websiteGradeBasis: grade of the website (SEO) score, as stored by the scoring pipeline

data.definition: open issues, distinct dedup_key, all categories (IssueAggregationService.getIssueSummary)

methodology.overallScore: Mean of the available category scores (SEO health, performance, technical health, AI readiness). Unavailable categories are excluded, never counted as 0. The category scores are produced by the existing scoring pipeline and are not recomputed here.
methodology.issueCounts: Open issues, counted once per distinct dedup_key across all categories (IssueAggregationService), identical to the dashboard Overview. Critical bucket = critical + high severity; medium; low bucket = low + info.
methodology.aiReadiness: AEO, GEO and AISO are on-site readiness assessments. Odito does not query AI platforms; no citation, mention or platform-ranking data is included.
methodology.timeSemantics: Scores come from the selected audit run. Issues, PageSpeed, technical and AI-hub data reflect the current project state (see snapshot.consistency). Keyword rankings carry their own scan timestamps. Search Console data is a separate reporting period.

warnings: The stored audit-run issue total differs from the canonical live count; the canonical count is reported.

categoryParity.note: On-page (non-Accessibility) + Accessibility should equal the all-category canonical total; a difference means other categories exist or the data changed between queries.

snapshotIssueTotal.note: AuditRun.totalIssues is captured from project.total_issues at audit completion; the canonical total is the live distinct open count. Report issue counts use the canonical total.
